projects.name: 生物防治中的竞争排斥模型研究
projects.program: Provincial Undergraduate Innovation and Entrepreneurship Training Program
projects.summary: Developed a competitive-exclusion model with diffusion and aggregation terms to study population competition in biological control, spatially heterogeneous resources, and individual aggregation behavior.
highlights: Led model derivation, qualitative analysis, and numerical simulation.
Used MATLAB for equation discretization, parameter experiments, and visualization.
